questions.prompt_html: \int \limits_{\Gamma} Pdx + Qdy + Rdz \text{化为关于弧长的曲线积分，其结果为（）。}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{解：} \quad \frac{dx}{dt} = 1 \ , \ \frac{dy}{dt} = 2t \ , \ \ \frac{dz}{dt} = 3t^2 \\ & \quad \cos \alpha = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+4t^2+9t^4}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+4y^2+9xz}} \\ & \quad \cos \beta = \frac{2t}{\sqrt{1+4t^2+9t^4}} = \frac{2x}{\sqrt{1+4y^2+9xz}} \\ & \quad \cos \gamma = \frac{3t^2}{\sqrt{1+4t^2+9t^4}} = \frac{3y}{\sqrt{1+4y^2+9xz}} \\ & \quad \int\limits_{\Gamma} Pdx + Qdy + Rdz = \int\limits_{\Gamma} \left( P \cos \alpha + Q \cos \beta + R \cos \gamma \right) ds = \int\limits_{\Gamma} \frac{P+2xQ+3yR}{\sqrt{1+4y+9xz}} ds \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{cases} \text{. 把第二型曲线积分} \int_{L} P(x,y)dx + Q(x,y)dy \text{化为第一型曲线积分，其中} L: y = \sqrt{x} \text{上从} (0,0) \text{到} (1,1) \text{的一段弧,其结果为}() \end{cases}

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{L} \frac{P(x,y) 2 \sqrt{x} + Q(x,y)}{\sqrt{1 + 4 x}} d s

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\int_{L} \frac{P(x,y) 2 \sqrt{x} + 2 Q(x,y)}{\sqrt{1+4x}} ds\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{array}{l} {l} \cdot \ \int _ { L } \frac { P ( x , y ) 2 \sqrt { x } + Q ( x , y ) } { \sqrt { 1 + x } } d s \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解：}\qquad y^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\,\,\,\,\,\text{,L的切向量}\,\,T=\{1,\,\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\}\\&\qquad\cos\alpha=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)^2}}=\frac{2\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1+4x}}\qquad\cos\beta=\frac{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)^2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+4x}}\\&\text{于是}\qquad\int_{L}P(x,y)dx+Q(x,y)dy=\int_{L}[P(x,y)\frac{2\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{1+4x}}+Q(x,y)\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+4x}}]ds\\&=\int_{L}\frac{P(x,y)2\sqrt{x}+Q(x,y)}{\sqrt{1+4x}}ds\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \int_{L} P(x,y)dx + Q(x,y)dy \text{化为对弧长的曲线积分，其中} L \text{为从点} (0,0) \text{沿上半圆周}

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{L} [ \sqrt{2\, x + x^{2}} \, P(x,y) + (1+x) Q(x,y) ] ds

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\int_{L} [\sqrt{2\, x + x^2} P(x,y) + (1-x) Q(x,y)] ds\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}\int_{L} [\sqrt{2\, x - x^2} \, P(x,y) + (1-x) Q(x,y)] ds\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{L} [ \sqrt{2\, x - x^{2}} \, P(x,y) + (1+x) Q(x,y) ] ds

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解：} \quad& L: \begin{cases} x=x \\ y=\sqrt{2x-x^{2}} \end{cases} \quad x: 0 \rightarrow 1, \text{由}0<1, \text{故在} (x,y) \text{处切向量为} \left(1, \frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}} \right), \text{所以} \\ & \cos \alpha = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\left( \frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}} \right)^{2}}} = \sqrt{2x-x^{2}}, \cos \beta = \frac{\frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}}}{\sqrt{1+\left( \frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}} \right)^{2}}} = 1-x, \text{所以} \\ & \int_{L} P\left( x,y \right) dx + Q\left( x,y \right) dy \\ & = \int_{L} \left[ P\left( x,y \right) \cos \alpha + Q\left( x,y \right) \cos \beta \right] ds \\ & = \int_{L} \left[ \sqrt{2x-x^{2}}P\left( x,y \right) + (1-x)Q\left( x,y \right) \right] ds \end{aligned}

options.label: A
options.html: \left| \int _ { L } P \mathrm{d} x + Q \mathrm{d} y \right| \geq M s

options.label: B
options.html: \left| \int _ { L } P \mathrm{d} x + Q \mathrm{d} y \right| \geq 2 M s

options.label: C
options.html: \left| \int _ { L } P \mathrm { d } x + Q \mathrm { d } y \right| \leq M s

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\left|\int_{L}P\,\mathrm{d}x+Q\,\mathrm{d}y\right|=\left|\int_{L}\left(P\cos\alpha+Q\cos\beta\right)\mathrm{d}s\right|\leq\int_{L}\left|P\cos\alpha+Q\cos\beta\right|\mathrm{d}s\\&\vec{A}=(P,Q),\ \vec{t}=(\cos\alpha,\cos\beta)\text{，二者夹角为}\theta,\\&\text{从而，}\int_{L}\left|P\cos\alpha+Q\cos\beta\right|\mathrm{d}s\ =\int_{L}\left|\vec{A}\cdot\vec{t}\right|\mathrm{d}s\ =\int_{L}\left|A\right|\left|\cos\theta\right|\mathrm{d}s\ \leq M\,s\end{aligned}
